news.headline: CEO Joe Burnett cash-exercises 12,517 options at $3.47 and holds every share
news.summary: In a Form 4 filed September 3 for a September 2 transaction, CEO and President Joseph Burnett exercised 12,517 stock options at $3.47, paid the exercise price in cash and retained all resulting shares rather than doing a cashless sell-to-cover. His direct holding rose to 130,720 shares plus 191,388 shares held through the Joseph M. Burnett Trust, an unusual signal after a year of insider selling.

news.headline: Partner uniQure submits AMT-130 BLA to FDA and MAA to UK MHRA for Huntington's disease
news.summary: uniQure submitted a Biologics License Application to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 (ifezuntirgene inilparvovec) with a Priority Review request, plus a parallel Marketing Authorisation Application to the UK MHRA, based on three-year Phase I/II data showing a statistically significant 75% slowing of progression on cUHDRS versus an external control (p=0.003). Every patient in those studies was dosed through the ClearPoint Neuro Navigation System and SmartFlow cannula, making this the first BLA built on ClearPoint's delivery platform in a large chronic indication.

news.headline: MAK Capital group discloses 7.8% passive stake in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund LP and MAK Capital One LLC reported 2,375,861 CLPT shares as of June 30, 2026, or 7.8% of the 30,504,227 shares outstanding, up from 1,901,489 shares (6.3%) disclosed on May 15. Filed nine days after the post-earnings selloff, the larger passive position points to institutional accumulation into the weakness, alongside BlackRock's 7.1% 13G from July 27.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro unveils five-pillar strategy targeting $500M in annual revenue
news.summary: Alongside the Q2 miss, management presented a long-term strategy aiming at $500M in annual revenue built on five pillars: cell and gene therapy delivery, the newly acquired 30,000 sq ft ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) preclinical site, the 10-year SONOCARE focused-ultrasound partnership at Sungkyunkwan University, a KUKA-arm cranial robot in development and Harmony 1.0 control software. Management cited 175+ active centers, 60+ pharma partners and expects high-teens to 20% revenue growth in 2027.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9M (+18%), misses estimates and cuts FY guidance to $48-52M
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 18% to $10.88M but landed roughly $1.8M below the $12.73M consensus, with neurosurgery navigation and therapy up 62% to $5.6M (including IRRAflow disposables) while biologics and drug delivery fell 15% to $4.0M on fewer products shipped for new trial starts. Opex rose 51% to $17.0M, the operating loss widened to $10.2M, cash fell to $29.4M from $45.9M at year-end, and FY2026 guidance was cut from $52-56M to $48-52M.

news.headline: Partner Aspen Neuroscience wins FDA RMAT designation for Parkinson's cell therapy delivered with ClearPoint hardware
news.summary: The FDA granted Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy designation to Aspen Neuroscience's sasineprocel (ANPD001), an autologous dopaminergic neuron replacement therapy for Parkinson's disease, on the strength of the ongoing Phase 1/2a ASPIRO trial. Every transplantation procedure in ASPIRO uses the ClearPoint Neuro Navigation System and the SmartFlow cannula, so RMAT's early and frequent FDA interactions and accelerated-approval eligibility put a second partner program on a faster route to commercial procedure volume.

catalysts.label: uniQure presents four-year AMT-130 follow-up data
catalysts.detail: uniQure has guided to topline four-year safety and efficacy data on all 24 patients from the first two AMT-130 cohorts (12 high-dose, 12 low-dose) in September 2026, using a June 30, 2026 data cut. Every one of those patients was dosed through ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and navigation system, so durability of the 75% progression-slowing signal seen at three years is the closest available read on the delivery platform performing over multiple years. A clean four-year dataset further de-risks the BLA now under FDA review; as of September 7 no exact presentation date has been announced.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings: biologics back to growth and cash-burn check
catalysts.detail: Management said the CAL preclinical facility came into ClearPoint's possession in July and that new services revenue should return the biologics and drug delivery segment, down 15% to $4.0M in Q2, to growth in Q3. The print is the first hard checkpoint on whether the cut to $48-52M guidance was a timing shift or a demand problem. With cash at $29.4M, opex up 51% year over year and an operating loss of $10.2M in Q2, investors will watch whether opex growth moderates or a capital raise moves onto the table. No date has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: FDA 60-day filing review decides acceptance and Priority Review for the AMT-130 BLA
catalysts.detail: uniQure submitted the AMT-130 BLA on September 2, 2026 with a Priority Review request, which would cut the FDA review clock from ten months to roughly six. Within the standard 60-day filing review, due around early November, the FDA will confirm whether the application is accepted and whether Priority Review is granted; uniQure is also preparing for a possible advisory committee. Sell-side analysts covering uniQure call acceptance the next incremental de-risking event, and it is the closest hard checkpoint on the single most important program in the ClearPoint delivery-platform thesis.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA review of the AMT-130 Marketing Authorisation Application
catalysts.detail: uniQure filed a parallel MAA with the UK MHRA on September 2, 2026 after a successful pre-submission meeting. A UK validation and subsequent review would extend ClearPoint's delivery platform into a second, ex-US commercial channel alongside the US accelerated-approval pathway and supports the company's global regulatory expansion pillar.

catalysts.label: Further partner BLA filings flagged on the Q2 call
catalysts.detail: Management stated on the August 3 call that multiple biopharma partners have recently received positive FDA feedback on potential BLA submissions and that additional cell and gene therapies should become commercially available by the end of 2027. Each partner filing beyond uniQure widens the base of recurring per-procedure delivery revenue and is the clearest way for ClearPoint to prove the platform thesis without depending on a single program.

catalysts.label: EpilepsyGTx EPY201 Phase 1/2a start
catalysts.detail: EpilepsyGTx announced in mid-July 2026 that it selected ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and navigation system for a first-in-human Phase I/IIa trial of EPY201 in focal refractory epilepsy, with the therapy slated to enter human studies in 2026. Trial initiation would convert the partnership announcement into actual procedure and service revenue and adds to the 10-15 trials management expects to be enrolling within 18 months.

catalysts.label: Aspen Neuroscience post-RMAT regulatory alignment
catalysts.detail: With RMAT designation granted on July 31, 2026 for sasineprocel (ANPD001), Aspen gains early and frequent FDA interactions and potential eligibility for priority review and accelerated approval for its autologous dopaminergic cell therapy in Parkinson's disease. An announced pivotal trial design or expanded ASPIRO enrollment would put a second approval pathway on ClearPoint hardware and lift procedure volumes ahead of any commercial launch.

catalysts.label: Partner trial ramp and roughly 10 data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the Q2 call to 10-15 clinical trials using ClearPoint technology enrolling patients over the next 18 months, plus roughly 10 partner data readouts. This is the core driver of the biologics and drug-delivery revenue line and the main evidence base needed to support the $500M long-term revenue ambition and the high-teens to 20% growth targeted for 2027.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 confirmatory Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: The FDA's agreement to accept a BLA under accelerated approval is contingent on uniQure running a prospective, randomized confirmatory trial. Every dosing in that study would again require ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow cannula, so trial initiation adds a multi-year stream of procedure and service revenue on top of any commercial launch volumes. Design details and timing have not been disclosed.

catalysts.label: First GLP IND-enabling study completed at CAL; robotics prototypes in preclinical use
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint signed its first GLP statement of work for the CAL facility, targeted for completion in 2027, and expects functioning cranial robot prototypes built around the KUKA LBR arm to be used preclinically at CAL and to generate incremental service revenue in 2027. Delivering both would prove out the capacity expansion from roughly $8M to over $60M in annual preclinical service capacity that underpins the new strategy.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA accelerated-approval decision on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: With the BLA filed September 2, 2026 and Priority Review requested, an FDA decision on the first Huntington's gene therapy could arrive as early as the first half of 2027 if Priority Review is granted, or in late 2027 under standard review. Approval would establish recurring per-procedure delivery revenue for ClearPoint and be the first commercial validation of the platform in a large chronic indication, following the Kebilidi precedent where SmartFlow is the only FDA-authorized delivery device.

pulse: CLPT closed around $13.96 in early September for a market cap near $425M, less than half the $30.10 52-week high, with the sell-side consensus target trimmed to roughly $23.50 after Stifel went to $22 and Lake Street to $25 (B. Riley still at $30). The week of September 3-7 brought no company press release; the only fresh datapoint is a Form 4 showing CEO Joe Burnett paid cash to exercise 12,517 options at $3.47 on September 2 and kept every share, which reads as a confidence signal after a stretch of insider selling. The story otherwise still hangs on partner uniQure, whose AMT-130 BLA and UK MAA went in on September 2 with Priority Review requested; the four-year Phase I/II readout on all 24 first-cohort patients is still promised for this month, and FDA filing acceptance is due around early November. Next to watch after that: the November Q3 print, where biologics has to reaccelerate on the new CAL facility or the $29.4M cash balance against a $10M quarterly operating loss becomes the story.
